Description: Sets the server name displayed in the server browser. Use underscores (_) instead of spaces!

Game.ini MapNameOverride. Accepts Ancestral_Plains, Ancestral_Plains_Canvas, DM_Caldera, DM_Caldera_Canvas, Forest_Island, Forest_Island_Canvas, IslaTitania, MainMenuScreenMap_MP, Rival_Shores, Rival_Shores_Canvas, Temporal_Drift, Test_Performance, BB_Test_Map (QA), or Volcano_Bay. Test maps, Volcano Bay, and Scorched Valley may lack major shrines.
Sets whether to display the actual map name in the server browser, or instead the Custom Display Map Name. This does not change the map that is loaded.
Sets a custom map name to display in the server browser, if Use Custom Display Map Name is selected under Display Map Name Mode
Sets the game mode for the server (command line and Game.ini GameMode)

Browser/rules label only. PvP marks a deathmatch server (no gameplay effect). PvE marks a genetics/nesting/chill server. PvPvE is the default. Chill servers often keep PvPvE because of event and PvE-mode oversights.
Sets the password required for players to join the server

Password passed on the server command line as AdminPassword. This is not Game.ini ServerAdminPassword. If this command-line password is set and you do not know it, in-game commands will not work. Use Server Admin Passwords on the Administration tab for the Game.ini key.
Game.ini ServerAdminPassword. Accepts multiple passwords separated by commas. Leave blank to omit the line. Separate from the command-line Admin Password field.
Sets the maximum number of players that can connect to the server at one time
If enabled, players can open the Discord invite from the in-game interface. Requires Discord Invite Code to be set.

Invite code only, not the full URL (the part after discord.gg/). Shown in-game when Display Discord Link is enabled. If Display Discord Link is off, leave this blank so Game.ini does not write DiscordLink=.

Game.ini bRequireSteamGroupToJoin. The Steam group check is broken and currently prevents joining the server. Keep this false. If it is false you must omit Steam Group Name or the game treats the check as true.

Steam group unique name. The Steam group check is broken and currently prevents joining. Leave this blank unless Require Steam Group To Join is true; an empty SteamGroupName= line also causes connection issues. This field is never written when empty.
Game.ini SteamWorkshopFoliageSaveItemIDs. Comma-separated workshop item IDs. Empty skips the line.
Game.ini GameServerLoginToken for Steam workshop foliage downloads. Empty skips the line.
Game.ini bUpdateFoliageFilesFromWorkshop. If false, the server keeps local workshop foliage copies.
Seconds between automatic saves. The game clamps this to a minimum of 30 seconds.
Food drain rate. Easy is half, Normal is default, Hard is double, Expert is triple.
Water drain rate. Easy is half, Normal is default, Hard is double, Expert is triple.
How quickly water becomes dirty. Easy is half, Normal is default, Hard is double, Expert is triple.
Multiplier for foliage spawn/regrowth relative to the normal rate.
Length of a full 24-hour in-game day in seconds. Default 7200. Day is 62.4% of this value and night is 37.6%. Examples: 3600 is a 1 hour cycle, 962 is a 10 minute day and 6 minute night.
Total meat spawned over time. Range 0 to 8. Default 1.0.
Size versus number of carcasses, 0 to 2. 2.0 (default) is tiny frequent carcasses. 0 is large rare carcasses.
Default true disables Restless. Set false to enable Restless, which punishes 100% shelter outside of poor weather, including light storms.
Default true disables random abandoned eggs. Set false to enable them. Abandoned eggs are not recommended on mixpacking or small servers and may be tied to a mixpacking group-visibility bug.
Chance a carcass spawn generates an abandoned egg. 0 stops egg spawns; 1 always spawns eggs instead of carcasses.

Game.ini TunnelNetworkDespawnTime: seconds until a tunnel despawns if nobody has dug in it. Guide default is 1800 (30 minutes). The game default is 259200 (3 days). Standing on assets such as BurrowBoulder02_C can cause DoS-level log spam for both server and client, so keep this timer low. Values below the 15 second server tick can lag or destabilize the server.
If true, portals are disabled. Palaeophis can cause CPU leaks at times when using portals.
If true, world events can spawn. Keep false unless you want events. Event chat in Global can become spammy.
Minutes from when a world event spawns until it starts.
World event duration in minutes.
Minutes between world events.

If enabled, writes WorldEventBuffsToNotUse=EVENT_WeatherImmunity under ServerGameInstance. The mapping prefix is the full line so Import ticks from that line and off does not write an empty WorldEventBuffsToNotUse=.

DisplayName: Disable Low Food and Water Drain Event
Description: If enabled, writes WorldEventBuffsToNotUse=EVENT_LowFoodWaterDrain under ServerGameInstance. The mapping prefix is the full line so Import ticks from that line and off does not write an empty WorldEventBuffsToNotUse=.

If enabled, writes WorldEventBuffsToNotUse=EVENT_AutoResurrection under ServerGameInstance. The mapping prefix is the full line so Import ticks from that line and off does not write an empty WorldEventBuffsToNotUse=.

If enabled, writes WorldEventBuffsToNotUse=EVENT_AISwarm under ServerGameInstance. The mapping prefix is the full line so Import ticks from that line and off does not write an empty WorldEventBuffsToNotUse=.

If enabled, writes WorldEventBuffsToNotUse=EVENT_Nesting under ServerGameInstance. The mapping prefix is the full line so Import ticks from that line and off does not write an empty WorldEventBuffsToNotUse=.

If enabled, writes WorldEventBuffsToNotUse=EVENT_GrowthBuff under ServerGameInstance. The mapping prefix is the full line so Import ticks from that line and off does not write an empty WorldEventBuffsToNotUse=.

If enabled, writes WorldEventBuffsToNotUse=EVENT_PledgeAmplify under ServerGameInstance. The mapping prefix is the full line so Import ticks from that line and off does not write an empty WorldEventBuffsToNotUse=.

One WorldEventBuffWeights entry per line. AMP writes WorldEventBuffWeights= in front of each line. Example: (Event=EVENT_AutoResurrection,Weight=2.0f). Does not write a + prefix.

WorldEventBuffsToNotUse values that are not one of the eight event toggles. One EVENT_ name per line. AMP writes WorldEventBuffsToNotUse= in front of each line. Empty skips the line so Game.ini does not get a trailing WorldEventBuffsToNotUse=.
UE units (centimeters) added to ocean height for high tide, low tide, and floods. Default 0. You will not see much difference until about 100. Negative values are allowed.
Default true disables the leaderboard. Set false to enable it (highest growth after creatures die or reset to 1.0).

Default true disables revenge-kill protection. Set false to stop players spawning a saved character within 750m of where they died, unless no other spawn is available. Should not apply to resurrection, reincarnation, or fresh spawns.
Default true disables UseRandomName. Set false to allow the command, which is similar to UseIncognito with a randomized name.
SaveSystem bDisableCharacterDeath. If true, Free Roam deaths auto-resurrect with no growth penalty.
If false, fires are disabled. If true, dry wildfires, lava-induced fires, and lightning-induced fires can spawn. Lava-induced fires are bugged.
Keeps flooding from getting too high. Disable to allow superfloods.
How high flood surge goes. 0 disables flooding. Values above 1 multiply flood height.
Enables tornado spawning during high-wind storms.
Enables stress caused by severe weather.
How fast the weather system runs. Higher is faster storms; lower is drawn-out weather.
How severe weather is. Higher is more extreme; lower is calmer.
How often storms spawn. Lower means storms back-to-back; higher means longer gaps.
Relative chance of rain. 0 disables this weather type.
Relative chance of fog. 0 disables this weather type.
Relative chance of overcast. 0 disables this weather type.
Relative chance of dry lightning. 0 disables this weather type.
Default true disables all AI spawning (less RAM). Set false to enable AI unless a species is disabled below. Aquatic AI, especially Malawania, use the most server resources.
Multiplies how often the AI respawn tick happens. Lower values respawn AI more frequently.
Multiplies how many AI may be active in each spawn region. Higher values allow more AI at cap.
If enabled, writes DisabledAITypes=EDinoType::Arganodus (no + prefix). The mapping prefix is the full line so a ticked box writes DisabledAITypes=EDinoType::Arganodus.
If enabled, writes DisabledAITypes=EDinoType::Auroraceratops (no + prefix). The mapping prefix is the full line so a ticked box writes DisabledAITypes=EDinoType::Auroraceratops.
If enabled, writes DisabledAITypes=EDinoType::HorseshoeCrab (no + prefix). The mapping prefix is the full line so a ticked box writes DisabledAITypes=EDinoType::HorseshoeCrab.
If enabled, writes DisabledAITypes=EDinoType::Malawania (no + prefix). The mapping prefix is the full line so a ticked box writes DisabledAITypes=EDinoType::Malawania.
Extra DisabledAITypes values not covered by the AI toggles. One EDinoType::Name per line. AMP writes DisabledAITypes= in front of each line.

Hard group configs and systems are heavily unfinished and buggy. Intended behavior blocks overpacking and kicks adults with a group-chat warning. Current behavior lets adults overpack unless they grow up in the group, and eggs can hatch out of group. Keep this false unless you accept those bugs.

Hard group configs and systems are heavily unfinished and buggy. bUseMixedHerdCaps is broken: eggs count toward the group limit and the rest of the system does not work. Keep this false and wait for the bugfix.

DisplayName: Ignore Group Species Check On Login
Description: Hard group configs and systems are heavily unfinished and buggy. Set true for mixed-species groups or members are removed from group on spawn/login.

If enabled, local chat is disabled.

One word per line. AMP writes ProfanityWords="word" style as ProfanityWords= in front of each line, so include the quotes in the line if needed, for example "SlurWordHere". Stars out matching words in non-admin chat. Words are also starred in the chat webhook.

One AutoMessages struct per line. AMP has no repeating Message/Interval/Alert/UTCTime field group, so this is a textarea. AMP writes AutoMessages= in front of each line. IntervalMinutes repeats the message; UTCTime fires once per day and is unreliable. Alert=true also shows an announcement. Example: (Message="Message repeating every hour", IntervalMinutes=60, Alert=false)
If enabled, players see MessageOfTheDay.txt on login (Game.ini bDisplayIntroMessage). The server does not create that file itself; AMP creates Config/Server/MessageOfTheDay.txt when missing.

Plain-text MOTD shown on login when Show Message of the Day is enabled. Multiline is supported. Optional tags: <red>text</>, <green>text</>, <blue>text</>, <green_outlined>text</>, <blue_outlined>text</>. There is no MOTD interval setting; the message is shown when a player joins. Written to BeastsOfBermuda/Config/Server/MessageOfTheDay.txt (WindowsServer and LinuxServer copies).
DefaultValue: Welcome to this Beasts of Bermuda server.

Description: If disabled, the server is in open-console mode and treats everyone as default admins. Leave enabled except for testing.
Game.ini ReservedAdminSlots. Hidden; default 2. Import consumes this key so the seed Game.ini has no unmatched lines. Raising reserved admin slots can lock admins out when the server is full.

AdminCommandRules lines whose CommandType is not one of the mapped commands. One remainder per line after AdminCommandRules=. Paste unmatched AdminCommandRules leftovers here.

Advanced. Untested since 12 April 2026, with many incompatibilities. Grants extra commands to a Steam64 that the rank would not have. One line per player. AMP writes AdminAllowedCommands= in front of each line. Example: (PlayerId=76561198000000000, Commands=("ForceStorm", "KickPlayer"))

Advanced. Untested since 12 April 2026, with many incompatibilities. Denies commands a rank would otherwise have. One line per player. AMP writes AdminBlockedCommands= in front of each line. Example: (PlayerId=76561198000000000, Commands=("RemoveAllCarcasses"))
One AdminRanks entry per line. AMP writes AdminRanks= in front of each line. Higher RankLevel inherits command rules from lower ranks. Example: (AdminRank="Owner",RankLevel=999)
One administrator per line. AMP writes ServerAdmins= in front of each line. Use SteamID64, not a persona name. Example: (UserSteamId64=76561198305957814,AdminRank="Owner")

One PlayerChatColors entry per line. AMP writes PlayerChatColors= in front of each line. Colors are normalized RGB 0-1 to one decimal. Example: (SteamID=76561198305957814,ChatColor=(R=1,G=0,B=0,A=1.0))
One PlayerChatTags entry per line. AMP writes PlayerChatTags= in front of each line. Example: (SteamID=76561198305957814,ChatTag="Contributor")
